deterministic.name: check-scoring-policy.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual application (private checker executables not available in this workspace; not a portal checker run). scoring.toml (byte-identical to template): [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0 with binary-only criteria; [weights] 0.6/0.2/0.2 summing to 1.0; [floors] functional=0.05; tests/gates/{render,constraints} and tests/scored/{functional,polish,visual} exist. test.sh runs gates (:213), score.py (:217), then scored (:224) and score.py (:227). Budget arithmetic: gates 600+600=1200 < 1500 (--max-concurrent-agent 1); scored: functional is mode individual, so 15 criteria x 600 s sequential = 9000, + polish 900 + visual 900 = 10800 < 11100; 1500+11100=12600 < 13200 verifier timeout. Risk: only 300 s scored headroom, and rewardkit retries a judge-response parse failure up to 3 times (judges.py _MAX_JUDGE_RETRIES = 3), so the worst case can exceed 11100 and zero the run (run_suite fails, leaving the gate-only record with floors_passed=0).
